fields.label: I am social, adventurous and open-minded. I like seeing a culture through the eyes of the people who
fields.default: I am social, adventurous and open-minded. I like seeing a culture through the eyes of the people who live there: listening first, trying the food and respecting local norms.

fields.label: Working as an assistant manager taught me to read people, bring humour to a moment and make room for
fields.default: Working as an assistant manager taught me to read people, bring humour to a moment and make room for everyone. Hostels bring that same sense of connection to a trip; the shared stories often matter more than an extra hour of sleep.

fields.label: I plan the essentials and leave room for detours. An early breakfast, exploring or taking it slow, a
fields.default: I plan the essentials and leave room for detours. An early breakfast, exploring or taking it slow, a drink somewhere new, dinner and a night out: I like a little bit of everything.

fields.default: I am an animal lover and try to make time for an animal park or zoo when I travel. Nature, wildlife, hiking, snorkelling and diving help me slow down. A gym session, bike ride or hike keeps my mind clear, at home or away.
